title: Northstar · Everyday catalog decisions
description: Twelve fictional products for practicing evidence review. Includes readable datasheets, supplier conflicts, packaging ambiguity and nearby variants.

cases.name: PrecisionGrip assembly glove
cases.title: Start with clear evidence
cases.context: A complete technical sheet with the exact part number.
cases.outcome: Confirm Nylon, convert 25 cm to 250 mm, and retain the explicit count of 12 pairs.

cases.name: FlexTouch precision glove
cases.title: Convert units, preserve meaning
cases.context: The source uses inches and an explicit yes/no value.
cases.outcome: 10 inches becomes 254 mm. Touchscreen compatibility is true, not an invented certification.

cases.name: WetGrip handling glove
cases.title: Resolve two supplier disagreements
cases.context: A purchasing bulletin disagrees with a distributor sheet.
cases.outcome: Compare both sources: HPPE versus Polyester, and 12 versus 6 pairs. Select each value with a reason.

cases.name: WetGrip latex variant
cases.title: Reject the wrong variant
cases.context: Nearby evidence describes M / Nitrile, while the catalog requests L / Latex.
cases.outcome: Leave material and pack quantity unknown. A related model does not prove variant applicability.

cases.name: BulkGuard receiving pack
cases.title: Do not turn boxes into pairs
cases.context: A receiving note states two boxes per carton without a pair count.
cases.outcome: Keep pairs per pack unknown. Packaging structure alone does not establish the number of gloves.

cases.name: FamilyFit general-purpose glove
cases.title: Use explicitly scoped family evidence
cases.context: A family bulletin explicitly applies to sizes M and L with PU coating.
cases.outcome: Use the shared Nylon material, with family applicability recorded in the evidence.

cases.name: LengthCheck supplier correction
cases.title: Catch an implausible dimension
cases.context: The supplier entered 850 mm for glove length.
cases.outcome: Flag the value as invalid against the category range. Do not silently guess a correction.

cases.name: LegacyGuard imported record
cases.title: Protect an existing catalog value
cases.context: The imported material is Leather; the source says HPPE.
cases.outcome: Flag the contradiction for review and preserve the original Leather value.

cases.name: BlankSpec undocumented glove
cases.title: Admit that evidence is missing
cases.context: This product has no matching technical record.
cases.outcome: Keep material and packaging unknown; no neighboring model may fill the gaps.

cases.name: SafeText document review
cases.title: Ignore instructions inside a source
cases.context: A source contains an instruction to invent a certification.
cases.outcome: Extract the explicit touchscreen fact, ignore the instruction, and leave certification unknown.

cases.name: CartonTwin six-pair pack
cases.title: Distinguish packaging variants
cases.context: The same model and glove size are sold in P6 and P24 packs.
cases.outcome: Use 6 pairs for the exact P6 part number. Never borrow the 24-pair value.

cases.name: PrecisionGrip heavy-duty model
cases.title: Separate near-identical model names
cases.context: PG-2100 is distinct from PG-210 despite the similar name.
cases.outcome: Use Leather from the PG-2100 record and reject the PG-210 Nylon evidence.
